snippet.title: Loonicycle | Free on itch.io!
snippet.description:
You don't need a license to ride a Unicycle 😎

Craig is a delivery boy trying to save up tons of Dosh, despite what the forecast says! Deliver passengers to their destinations to earn money & stay on the clock. Don't get caught in inclement weather or your luck might just spin out! 

Made for the Major Jam 7: Wild. Play it free here: https://johndamico99.itch.io/loonicycle
